subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should referenced shared plugins remain removable with warnings only, or must removal require explicit force consent?
rationale: Code correctness cannot determine whether operator control should permit immediate breakage of dependent Claw agents; that policy affects later status, removal, update, doctor, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Keep Advisory Removal
options.body: Permit warning-only removal after dependency visibility, recovery behavior, trust ordering, canonical persistence, and real proof are complete.

options.title: Require Explicit Force
options.body: Block removal while Claw references exist unless the operator deliberately accepts dependent-agent breakage.

options.title: Defer Shared Plugins
options.body: Limit the first package slice to workspace-local skills until shared dependency ownership is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Advisory Removal
recommendation.body: Permit warning-only removal after dependency visibility, recovery behavior, trust ordering, canonical persistence, and real proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent shared plugin-management implementation is the primary enforcement point for the chosen removal policy.
